sonnov.title: гость на празднике бон
sonnov.about:
Жизнь — тоже книга, это сравнение банально как жизнь. Что толку читать ее до конца, если все главное сказано на первых страницах? А если ты понял это, стоит ли копаться в мелком шрифте бесчисленных примечаний? Смерть в юности, когда человек еще чист и прекрасен, — вот лучшее из возможного, но я понял это лишь тогда, когда моя собственная юность уже прошла. Оставалось одно — приготовить себя должным образом, изменившись настолько, насколько позволяла природа. В этом, конечно, было что-то искусственное, но все же это было лучше, чем оскорбить смерть старческим безобразием, как поступает большинство.
«Гость на празднике Бон»

sonnov.title: A tribute to Eliane Radigue
sonnov.about:
January 24, 1932 - February 23, 2026
This album is a tribute to and memory of Eliane Radigue.
She is often referred to as the Drone Grandmother, who stands at the origins of the musical genre known as drone.
We all owe her a debt of gratitude for revealing sound in a completely new way.
During her musical career, which Radigue began in 1950, she studied with people such as Pierre Schaeffer and Pierre Henri.
Later, she began to develop her own recognizable sound.
We have lost a very significant world-class figure. But we will always remember you.
Thank you for the inspiration.

sonnov.title: Angel Forever  / A lonely strain
sonnov.about:
This album is the quintessence of all the pain of the last four years.
Six years of relationship left a mark that literally burned my soul at the very end of my mental anguish, which only ended in August 2025.
The album tells the story of extremely warm and joyful moments that will never happen again. These were definitely the best six years in the life of the author of this album.
The album is an attempt to say a final goodbye to his past, which remained the warmest and most joyful moment for him until 2021.
NEXT WILL BE A MESSAGE FROM THE AUTHOR OF THE IDEA FOR THIS ALBUM, WHOSE LIFE IS DESCRIBED IN THIS ALBUM.
My angel, I don't know if you'll ever see this message, but thank you for everything you've ever done for me. I know and remember that you always wanted to go to Japan and live in Finland. I hope you're happy.
I know you've been watching me all these years since we broke up. I don't know why, I don't know how. But you did.
You can keep watching me, but it's time for me to move on. I burned all the diaries that reminded me of you. I don't want to go back to that old life anymore, because after we broke up, my life went downhill.
I lost my Husky dog.
Two of my friends died.
My mother's father died.
I don't even want to remember 2021-2023.
In 2024, I finally managed to break this cycle for a while. But the happiness didn't last long. In 2025, I almost died, and I've been fighting the cause for half a year now.
All this happened in just the last four years. It's as if I've been cursed.
But now I'm fine.
Because you will remain in my heart, and you will be the only reason for my inner strength for the next four years.
This album is dedicated to you as my last words of farewell.
____
286 tracks of memories filled with sadness and warmth.
All ideas and selection of source material belong to Dark Echo Forest. Implementation and execution by Ivan Sonnov.
Everything was recorded by hand—no neural networks were used.

sonnov.title: BLAKEOUT
sonnov.about: The album by Astral & Shit , BARDOSENETICCUBE and D.O.J. Stone,, and many more impressive musicians with interesting past (like the cello player of the cult band Chimera) has a violent and high-quality sound accompanied by gnostic ideology. The album is pretty much about Blake’s poetry and exploitation of the Brittish esoteric underground aesthetics. This exploitation is so consistent that it happens to come to mind that the goal of an album was simply to copy all the important features of the discussed aesthetics. Here we have the songs about Satan with acoustic guitar, the timid voice that resembles David Tibet, of course an echoing extraterrestrial cacophony in the style of the Coil and etc. But this album is not simply an epigone on the great ones. It is a vivid story about a tragedy of an artist in the existential void. For example, in “The Fly” noise is accompanied by a song for kids and electric guitar. And there are lots of other intriguing features in this work that are for you to explore for the first time in your life.

sonnov.title: Cikiqugulu
sonnov.about: A fugue of static and soil—petrified shadows where light fractures into granular decay. No markers, no names; only the geometry of absence, carved by wind that carries the scent of rusted iron and wilted stems. The earth hums in a register below mourning, a subsonic hymn to collapse. You trace contours that aren’t there: the brush of lichen on stone, the sigh of roots threading through marrow. It’s not a place. It’s an equation—where gravity bends toward silence, and every breath becomes a relic. The closer you listen, the clearer it grows: the dead don’t rest. They resonate.

sonnov.title: cikiyab
sonnov.about: A pulse without genesis—limitless, directionless, seeping into fissures unseen. The atmosphere bends, a web of pressure humming in a tongue of fractured calculus. Chronology fractures. Dimensions warp. There is no axis, only the drone of an engine born from absence. You are not a body but an aperture, reflecting wavelengths that shear purpose from vibration. What lingers isn’t void. It’s the residue of a plea cast into ether, atomized into the white noise between synapses.

sonnov.title: Gugiz
sonnov.credits:
released March 2, 2025
A fugue of static and soil—petrified shadows where light fractures into granular decay. No markers, no names; only the geometry of absence, carved by wind that carries the scent of rusted iron and wilted stems. The earth hums in a register below mourning, a subsonic hymn to collapse. You trace contours that aren’t there: the brush of lichen on stone, the sigh of roots threading through marrow. It’s not a place. It’s an equation—where gravity bends toward silence, and every breath becomes a relic. The closer you listen, the clearer it grows: the dead don’t rest. They resonate.

Things move without motion: a flutter of leaves that are not leaves, a ripple where no water flows. The air tastes of static and sap, thick with the musk of fungi dreaming in reverse. You are neither lost nor found. The forest breathes through you, its pulse a dissonance that rewrites the map of your veins. To enter is to become a rumor—a flicker in the periphery of a world that forgets itself with every step.

sonnov.about: A labyrinth of petrified breath—trees arch like frozen hymns, their bark etched with glyphs of unspoken seasons. The light here is a thief, stealing color, leaving only the afterimage of paths that loop into themselves. Shadows don’t follow; they lead, pooling at your feet as liquid obsidian, whispering in a dialect of wind and bone. Things move without motion: a flutter of leaves that are not leaves, a ripple where no water flows. The air tastes of static and sap, thick with the musk of fungi dreaming in reverse. You are neither lost nor found. The forest breathes through you, its pulse a dissonance that rewrites the map of your veins. To enter is to become a rumor—a flicker in the periphery of a world that forgets itself with every step.

sonnov.title: Sigehov
sonnov.about:
Imagine light filtered through frozen glass, warping the world into fractured cerulean. What rises isn’t melody but the residue of collapse—sub-bass like tectonic shifts, high-end hiss like wind carving stone. It’s the sound of distance: horizons swallowing themselves, shadows pooling where blue turns to ink. There are no rhythms, only pulses—a faint throb beneath the surface, as if the air itself is infected. Listen too closely, and it might follow you back.
Music - Соннов

Astral & Shit - сольный проект Гомзикова. Абсолютная свобода эксперимента со звуком. Талант музыканта представляется нам, как и в работе над нойзом - так и над эмбиентом.
По словам музыканта, задача его музыки – задача любой Энергии - трансформация сознания и духа.
Для Astral & Shit основной интерес заключается именно в создании музыки.
В этом альбоме вы услышите глубокий пронизывающий дрон, в который постепенно вплетаются звуки окружающего мира. Палитра звуков. Музыка обретает формы. Где-то вдалеке звучат женские напевы.
При прослушивании альбома чувствуешь себя раненным зверем, лежащим на снегу и глядящим в бесконечно прекрасное ночное небо.

sonnov.about: A labyrinth of petrified breath—trees arch like frozen hymns, their bark etched with glyphs of unspoken seasons. The light here is a thief, stealing color, leaving only the afterimage of paths that loop into themselves. Shadows don’t follow; they lead, pooling at your feet as liquid obsidian, whispering in a dialect of wind and bone. Things move without motion: a flutter of leaves that are not leaves, a ripple where no water flows. The air tastes of static and sap, thick with the musk of fungi dreaming in reverse. You are neither lost nor found. The forest breathes through you, its pulse a dissonance that rewrites the map of your veins. To enter is to become a rumor—a flicker in the periphery of a world that forgets itself with every step.
